sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 350. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 80 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for physical attacks by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for magic attacks by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
